description: Add a keyword for a project's scans to search, or update one already added. A project with at least one keyword is included in the daily scheduled scan (06:00 UTC). Free.

competitors.description: Competitor names to store with this keyword, up to 25; replaces the stored list. Scans currently search the project's own competitor list, not this one.

keyword.description: Phrase to search for in every scan of this project, 2-120 characters, e.g. "alternative to Mixpanel". Subscribing the same keyword again updates it.

project_id.description: Project to monitor for. Get ids from list_projects.

name: subscribe_to_keyword
title: Monitor a keyword
